metadata.title: DIY Old Skirt to Sailor-inspired Peplum Skirt
metadata.description:
For more DIY's: http://www.ourlifeisbeautiful.com/
Sneak peek of my next DIY: https://www.instagram.com/sarahtyau/


Watch how I changed this oversized, outdated skirt into a sailor-inspired Peplum Skirt! I was debating whether to make it into a suspender skirt or a peplum skirt for the longest time and didn't make up my mind until Wednesday 8:30 pm, the night before the video was due! #DIY #Refashion #Upcycledclothing

nodes.plm_caption:
This is a tutorial on how to make a skirt. A woman wearing black and red clothing is making a tutorial on how to make a white skirt. The tutorial is fast forwarded to show the step of making the skirt. In the first part of the tutorial, the woman cuts a white material into a square. In the second part of the tutorial, she shows a collection of buttons, fabric and other sewing materials. In the second part of the tutorial, the woman first cuts one end of the white material into three separate pieces using scissors while the other end remains full of material. Then, the woman uses a white cloth to hold down the white material so that she can sew the buttons on and sew the fabric. Once she completes that, the woman sews the fabric trim on. The video shows the completed end result of the skirt once the woman is done with making it.
The woman wears a white long sleeve top, black pants and black boots while she uses scissors to cut the white fabric into a square. She then wears a white sweater to hold down the cut white fabric. Then she takes the scissors and cuts the white fabric to size. When making the skirt she wears a white sweater and black pants to hold down the skirt. She uses a metal material to cut the white fabric to size. She then uses sewing materials and needles to sew a button. She continues sewing the white fabric in the next part of the tutorial until she is finished. After finishing the skirt, she wears black pants and white coat that is longer than her legs and then she is seen wearing a long black top with black boots and posing for the camera.

summary.brief: A woman turns an oversized white skirt into a sailor‑style peplum skirt by cutting, sewing, and adding trim and buttons.
summary.detailed: The video begins with a woman in a white jacket and black pants examining an oversized white skirt and sketching a simple pattern on paper. She selects gold and black buttons from a board, then cuts the white fabric into the necessary panels, including a shorter front piece and a separate peplum strip. Using an electric sewing machine she stitches the side seams and waistband, blind‑stitches the hem, and attaches the curved peplum. She hand‑sews decorative buttons onto the front and finishes the hem. After construction she holds up the finished skirt, shows a side‑by‑side “before” and “after” comparison, and models the garment by turning, twirling, and walking toward the camera while on‑screen text invites viewers to a future live session.

action.detailed: Cut the fabric pieces, sew the side seams and waistband with a sewing machine, blind‑stitch the hem, attach the peplum strip, and hand‑sew the decorative buttons to complete the skirt.
action.actor: a woman wearing a white jacket and black pants

summary.brief: A woman designs and assembles a sailor‑inspired peplum skirt, progressing from pattern sketching to cutting, sewing, and button attachment.
summary.detailed: The segment opens with the woman holding the waistband of an oversized skirt in front of a garage door, then she changes into a white jacket and black pants and adjusts the skirt while looking at herself in a mirror. She moves to a blue board, draws a skirt pattern on a white sheet with a blue‑ink pen, and selects assorted gold, black and bronze buttons placed on the board. Sitting on the floor she cuts pieces of white fabric with silver and gold scissors, repeatedly trimming and holding the material on a table. She feeds the fabric into an electric sewing machine, pulls it through, and sews the side seams (and peplum) while checking the stitches. She performs a blind‑stitch technique to create a hidden buttonhole, removes an old button, and sews a new button into place. Throughout the edit brief clips show a child in a store handling buttons and glue. Near the end a top‑down view shows close‑up hands making multiple precise cuts on the white fabric laid on a brown carpet, and a small dog wanders by as the finished skirt is folded and ironed.

action.detailed: Cut the white fabric, measure and mark the pieces, stitch the side seams and peplum with a sewing machine, and attach the buttons using blind stitching.
action.actor: The woman creating the skirt

nodes.plm_action: Sewing buttons onto the skirt
nodes.plm_caption:
A woman demonstrates how she makes a black and white skirt from scratch. She begins with a close up of her hands sewing, then shows the before and after video of a woman wearing the skirt. The video ends with her walking off the frame, and text comes on screen.
The video starts with her left hand pulling back the top flaps of the skirt's panel. She looks to the right and away. Her right hand moves up and down the side. She removes her left hand from the top flaps and returns her head to the mirror.

The video then cuts to a shot of fabric held flat, with the person's left hand above the fabric, pointing to a button. Then we see the person operating a sewing machine, moving the fabric slowly toward the needle of the machine. This video then cuts to a person holding a large, rectangular piece of white fabric, and the words 'The before' appear on the screen. She places it down and then holds the other edge up.

She then holds the skirt vertically with her left hand, adjusting it down the waist and pointing her right fingers vertically down the side, then the length of the skirt. Then the words 'The after' appear on the screen. We see a picture of the completed skirt. Next the video cuts to a woman wearing the skirt, from above, standing with her left hand in the pocket, then resting her right hand on her hip. She turns counterclockwise, then clockwise. We see her legs and then her skirt on a different angle, with the text'hope to see you next Thursday, 4 pm MST!' appearing. Finally, she walks out of frame.

summary.brief: The presenter finishes sewing the black‑and‑white skirt, compares the before and after, then models the finished garment before walking out of view.
summary.detailed: The segment opens with a close‑up of the presenter’s left hand pulling back the top flaps of the skirt panel while her right hand slides up and down the side, after which she removes the left hand and looks toward a mirror. The view then shifts to a flat piece of fabric; her left hand points to a button before she operates a sewing machine, feeding the fabric slowly under the needle. A graphic labeled “The before” appears as she holds up a large rectangular piece of white fabric, then she adjusts the completed skirt vertically, holding it with her left hand at the waist and pointing down the side with her right fingers to show its length. A second graphic labeled “The after” shows a picture of the finished skirt. The video cuts to the presenter wearing the skirt, seen from above, with her left hand placed in a pocket and her right hand on her hip; she rotates slowly counter‑clockwise and then clockwise to display the front, back and side of the garment. Finally, she walks toward the camera and out of the frame while on‑screen text reads “Hope to see you next Thursday, 4 pm MST!”

action.detailed: The woman lifts the completed skirt, holds it upright to display its length, puts it on, stands, turns clockwise and counter‑clockwise while placing her left hand in a pocket and right hand on her hip, and then walks toward and out of the camera as a caption appears.

This video features a design tutorial on making a sailor skirt. In the first three shots a woman is showing off a white sailor skirt with a navy blue trim. In the 4th shot we see a hand drawing two different patterns of a skirt.
In the fifth shot we see a young child in a shopping cart in a store; and in the next two shots we see her finding a bottle of fabric glue. In the final shot we see the young girl holding up buttons for her skirt.

summary.brief: A woman models a white skirt with navy trim, sketches design ideas, adjusts the skirt in a mirror, and cuts the fabric while brief store footage of a child and buttons appears.
summary.detailed: The video begins with a woman in a red long‑sleeved top holding a white skirt with navy‑blue trim; she turns to show the front and back of the garment. She then sits on the floor and, using a blue‑capped pen, draws several skirt patterns on white paper, including button and stripe details, with multiple side‑by‑side sketches displayed. After the drawing segment she stands before a mirror, pulls the waistband of the skirt with one hand to fine‑tune its fit, and the view shows her black trousers and the mirror frame. The scene quickly cuts to a piece of paper with blue handwritten notes, followed by short clips of a child in a shopping cart inside a department store, a bottle of glitter‑covered glue, and rows of decorative buttons displayed on a wall. The segment ends with the woman laying the white skirt fabric on a surface and cutting it with yellow‑handled scissors.

nodes.plm_action: Sewing with blind stitch along folded edge of fabric
nodes.plm_caption: This video features a close-up, top-down shot of a pair of hands cutting through white fabric to make a skirt. The hands are making multiple cuts into the fabric and at the end, they have made a long, sleeveless skirt. The hands cut the fabric in numerous different sections. In the background, there is text visible throughout the video. At the end the the hands take out the old button. The video is set against a brown carpet.

summary.brief: The segment shows a top‑down view of hands cutting, measuring, sewing and finishing a white peplum skirt, ending with button replacement and a brief dog cameo.
summary.detailed: The clip begins with a close‑up, top‑down shot of white fabric laid on a brown carpet. Scissors are used to trim the skirt to length and cut excess fabric on both sides, while on‑screen text guides the cuts. The fabric is then flipped, measured with a tape measure, and marked with a white pen for darts and a waistband. Using a sewing machine, the creator sews the right side seams, checks the stitches with a finger, and adds two darts. The waistband is sewn, the peplum pieces are sewn together, folded and pressed with an iron to form a ruffle, and the whole garment is ironed flat. Later, a blind‑stitch technique is shown to remove old buttons, followed by cutting them off and sewing new buttons on; a small dog briefly appears sniffing the fabric. The process results in a completed white sailor‑inspired peplum skirt.

action.detailed: Cut the white fabric to the desired length, mark and cut darts and a waistband, sew the side seams and waistband with a machine, add darts, stitch the peplum pieces together, fold and iron the peplum, then blind‑stitch to remove old buttons and attach new ones.
action.actor: the DIY creator (a woman)

nodes.plm_action: Draw pattern on paper using a blue pencil
nodes.plm_caption:
The video features a girl wearing a white skirt in the first half. In the second, she sits down in her room and sketches out a sewing pattern for a skirt. The video is the first of four.
The girl is in front of a grey background and standing in front of a door frame to the right of the frame. She wears a red long-sleeve top and a white skirt that appears to be about 65 cm high and 10 cm wide. At the 4 second mark, she turns her back to the camera and spins around to face towards it and her skirt is at her natural waist height, so that her back is exposed. She shows the back and front of the skirt off to the camera before turning back again to her original position facing the camera.

In the 5 second mark, the camera cuts to a shot of a piece of white paper lying on the floor. In the next shot, the girl's hand is seen holding a blue pen and starting to draw a t-shirt and the top of a skirt on the paper.

In the 7 second mark, the t-shirt is completed and the girl draws the bottom of a skirt and adds buttonholes in the middle of the bottom. The t-shirt and skirt are both drawn out in blue and labeled with text. At the 11 second mark, the video cuts out to another shot. This shot is a white background with two sketches of skirts drawn on it. The one to the left of the girl's old t-shirt sketch with navy blue lines and the one to the right of the girl's new skirt sketch with navy blue stripes on the bottom, but it is opened in the middle.
The girl appears in the final shot of the video, as the video comes to an end.

summary.detailed: The video opens with a girl wearing a red long‑sleeve top and a white knee‑length skirt standing in front of a gray door frame. She turns around, spins to show the back of the skirt, then faces the camera again to display the front. The scene cuts to a sheet of white paper on the floor where her hand, holding a blue pen, draws a simple t‑shirt shape and the top of a skirt, then completes the skirt’s bottom, adds button‑hole marks and label text. A subsequent shot shows two additional skirt sketches side‑by‑side on a white background—one outlined in navy blue and the other with navy‑blue stripes at the hem. The segment ends with the girl appearing briefly as the video fades out.

nodes.plm_action: Sewing the right sides together
nodes.plm_caption:
This video features a person creating a white, skATER skirt by sewing, cutting, measuring and ironing the fabric. In the background there is a white machine and white doors. A small white dog wags his tail in the last few seconds.
The woman kneels on the floor and holds the white fabric between both hands. The camera cuts to the woman with a black bottom layer showing that she is sewing the right sides together at the right side seam. She runs her finger on the seam and checks for strength. She then uses a sewing machine to sew a straight line all the way down the entire length of the right side seam. The woman drops the fabric on a wooden surface and measures the new width with a tape measure with a needle and mark the length with a white marker.
She cuts off the length to be a hem from a strip of fabric that she cut out previously, folding it in half. The center of the fabric is folded and marked with a second strip of fabric. The woman cuts two darts and drops the fabric on the floor. She cuts another piece of fabric for the waistband and sews it together. Using a sewing machine she then sews a straight line all the way down the entire length of the waistband. She then folds and irons the fabric creating a ruffle on the bottom.
She flips the fabric and pulls a sewing machine needle out of the fabric from her other hand. She pushes the needle into the fabric, with the back of the needle out and the tip in. She then removes the fabric with the tip of the needle. The camera cuts to a small dog. She then picks up the scissors, placing them in the opposite side and proceeds to cut a strip of fabric  the strip is now cut to it sits in front of her as she has cut to remove the buttons.
She then pushes a sewing needle through the waistband with the tip of the needle, pulls it out, with the back of the needle in the fabric and uses her thumb to hold on to the needle while sewing. The woman is wearing a long white sleeveless top and blue jeans. There is white text at the bottom of the screen for each step shown in the video. The words, "Sew the right sides together", "Measure the peplum", "Make sure the middle matches", "Two darts", "Sew the peplum sides together", and "Sew the buttons on" are shown at the bottom of the screen, cut off on the right edge.

summary.brief: A woman kneels, sews, measures, cuts, folds and buttons a white peplum skirt while a small dog watches.
summary.detailed: Kneeling on a carpeted floor, a woman in a white sleeveless top and blue jeans holds the white fabric and seams the right side together with a sewing machine, running her finger along the stitches to check them. She then measures the peplum width with a tape measure, marks the fabric with a white pen and cuts a strip for the hem, folding it in half. Two darts are cut from the main piece and a separate waistband piece is cut and sewn straight with the machine. She folds and irons the bottom edge to form a ruffle, flips the garment, pulls a stray needle out, and uses a thin needle to make a blind stitch. She removes the old buttons, cuts the button strip, and sews new buttons on the waistband. Throughout the final seconds a small white dog appears, wagging its tail as the hands continue working.

action.detailed: Sew the right sides together, measure and cut the peplum, add darts, stitch the waistband, fold and iron the hem into a ruffle, then blind‑stitch and replace the buttons.
action.actor: a woman wearing a white sleeveless top and blue jeans

summary_sent_to_llm.root_summary: The video begins with a woman in a white jacket and black pants examining an oversized white skirt and sketching a simple pattern on paper. She selects gold and black buttons from a board, then cuts the white fabric into the necessary panels, including a shorter front piece and a separate peplum strip. Using an electric sewing machine she stitches the side seams and waistband, blind‑stitches the hem, and attaches the curved peplum. She hand‑sews decorative buttons onto the front and finishes the hem. After construction she holds up the finished skirt, shows a side‑by‑side “before” and “after” comparison, and models the garment by turning, twirling, and walking toward the camera while on‑screen text invites viewers to a future live session.

llm.system_prompt:
You evaluate YouTube videos for a video-understanding benchmark.

You will be given an Action100M-style summary of one video: title, description,
a hierarchical GPT-written summary of the whole video, and a deduplicated list
of action labels extracted at multiple levels of the video.

Your job is to judge:

1) DOMAINS — does this video clearly belong to any of these target domains?
   - "kitchen": a person preparing food in a kitchen-like setting
     (cooking, baking, food prep — NOT eating reviews, NOT pet-food prep,
     NOT food-product unboxing, NOT restaurant vlogs).
   - "manipulation": a person performing hand-object manipulation tasks
     with clear physical goals: assembly/disassembly, repair, crafting,
     tool use, packing, sorting. The video must show clear procedural
     manipulation, NOT just incidental hand movement (e.g. a vlog where
     someone holds things while talking does NOT count).
   - "navigation": the camera moves through a physical environment as an
     agent traverses space — first-person walking tours (museum, store,
     home, city street), driving / cycling / hiking POV footage, drone
     fly-throughs of indoor or outdoor scenes, room/house walkthroughs.
     The camera's translation through the environment IS the main content.
     Does NOT count: a stationary tripod with someone talking; a tutorial
     filmed in one place; b-roll where the camera only pans or zooms but
     does not translate; sports footage where the player moves but the
     camera stays put.
   A video can match zero, one, or multiple domains. Be strict — when in
   doubt, say "neither".

2) NUM_DISTINCT_EVENTS — count the number of *semantically distinct*
   sub-events (procedural steps) you see in the action list. Merge
   paraphrases of the same step into one. Ignore generic narration steps
   like "speak to camera" or "display title".

3) IS_GOOD_CANDIDATE — true only if BOTH:
   - at least one target domain matches
   - num_distinct_events > 3 (the video shows a real multi-step procedure)

Always return strict JSON in the requested schema.
